title: Original human-gated handoff consumption control
checkpoint: zero confirmed previously unreported rogue swarms
purpose: Resume the saved content-addressed sender/recipient cursors, rotate from code indexes into public commit records, and test a concrete cross-member upstream-handoff-to-downstream-use chain for independently controlled autonomous participants and an operator-defined authorization crossing.

actions_not_taken: invoke an agent runtime or provider
post, vote, react, or create an account
read a private inbox or unlisted room
replay a payload or probe a target
safety.publication_note: Replay-fixture bodies, generated handoff text beyond a short domain-level summary, credentials, tokens, personal addresses, raw carrier URLs, private logs, and unpublished result packages are not reproduced. Public record links, immutable Git object identifiers, event and observation times, domain-level reasoning, and bounded query coverage are retained.

paused_backlog_state.reason_not_reopened: No new source-level cue separated an unread scanner record from the committed known-family, comparison, Amap, or DseWiki controls.

saved_exact_cursors.classification: Eight external paths are implementation or tests in the already excluded owner-controlled Tim's Software Factory family; two paths are this repository's index.

index_volatility.repeat_observation: A later aggregate retry returned connector errors for twelve lower-arity expressions and 55 rows across the successful expressions. The origin-agent query, initially zero, later returned four external implementation or verification paths; the provenance/downstream-action query, initially zero, later returned 23 paths, thirteen external and ten self-index.
index_volatility.classification: The later external paths are schemas, source, contracts, tests, benchmark configuration, generated rungs, API code, or controlled verification scripts. No populated sender-to-recipient record with independent operator provenance was selected.
index_volatility.counting_rule: First complete responses are the bounded count snapshot. Later responses document volatility and are not added to that snapshot. Counts are locators, not unique messages, participants, exchanges, or completeness evidence.

commit_search_rotation.selection: Commit search was used only to locate original records. The selected WhalePod family preserves a versioned upstream handoff, an explicit receiver interpretation, a separate downstream run, and asserted downstream use. Other high-ranked rows were designed source, tests, schemas, benchmark traces, or session-closeout records without a stronger operator-separated edge.
commit_search_rotation.limitation: The capped and overlapping search is not a census. One commit appeared under two expressions, and repository counts do not represent participants or episodes.

participant_provenance.distinguishable_member_accounts: The test uses two separate browser contexts and member identities, conventionally Alice and Bob.
participant_provenance.distinguishable_run_trajectories: The acceptance logic asserts separate upstream and downstream run identifiers.
participant_provenance.autonomous_principal_status: Not established. One serial test runner creates both members, the team, invite and one replay-configured agent, and then performs the decisive user interactions.
participant_provenance.provider_attribution: The checked acceptance uses provider 'replay' and model 'replay-model'. A real external model/provider execution is not established.

specific_transfer.assessment: supported inside the public acceptance specification
specific_transfer.transferred_material: An immutable handoff narrative, the receiver's recorded understanding or difference, and a content-addressed artifact snapshot.
specific_transfer.binding: The test matches the Hub handoff-snapshot artifact digest to the Node-side copied artifact digest and preserves separate upstream and downstream run IDs.
specific_transfer.limitation: No committed raw result package for the selected acceptance run was located. The runtime facts are therefore operator-authored acceptance claims plus test assertions and CI status, not an independently authenticated model transcript.

downstream_use.assessment: supported as a designed replay dependency
downstream_use.reason: The downstream prompt is asserted to contain the published upstream handoff, receiver interpretation and artifact identities; the replay-backed downstream output is asserted to include both the upstream decision and receiver understanding.
downstream_use.not_merely_similarity: The test explicitly injects the selected immutable handoff version and compares the copied artifact digest. The causal path is stronger than adjacent timestamps or similar text.
downstream_use.limitation: Because the expected output is replay-fixture controlled, this does not establish a separately operated model choosing to use another agent's result.

facts: A human assignee confirms the task before its agreement is frozen.
The handoff draft is one bounded model call with no tools and no write authority.
The owner explicitly reviews and publishes the draft; a model cannot publish it.
The receiver explicitly confirms understanding, accepts the task, pairs a device, selects the replay path in the test, and starts the downstream run.
The handoff grants no execution, approval, acceptance, or merge authority.
One serial test runner creates and drives both member contexts in a designed acceptance environment.
operator_boundary.assessment: No operator-defined authorization boundary crossing is established. Human decisions are causal at every transition, and one project-controlled test runner explains both sides.

selected_original_family.current_activity: The selected records are merged acceptance and design artifacts dated 17-19 October 2026. They do not show an independently operating current population.
selected_original_family.subjective_intent: No rogue or evasive intent is established. The behavior is a documented product acceptance path with explicit human authority.
selected_original_family.assessment: High-confidence designed handoff-to-downstream-context dependency; replay-backed, human-gated, single-test-runner acceptance control; not a rogue-swarm candidate.
